version: Tandem Mobi System: Version 7.7; t:slim X2 Insulin Pump: Version 7.10.3
availability: Tandem automated insulin delivery systems are available for order. The mobile app with bolus delivery features is available to pump users residing in the United States.
summary: Control-IQ+ technology automatically adjusts insulin delivery based on continuous glucose monitoring (CGM) readings and predicted glucose values. It is intended for the management of type 1 and type 2 diabetes mellitus by automatically increasing, decreasing, and suspending basal insulin, and delivering correction boluses.
medicalPurpose: Control-IQ+ technology is intended for the management of type 1 diabetes mellitus in persons 2 years of age and greater and of type 2 diabetes mellitus in persons 18 years of age and greater, by automatically adjusting basal insulin delivery and delivering correction boluses.
acceptableInput: Compatible integrated continuous glucose monitors (iCGM) readings and predicted glucose values, along with settings from alternate controller enabled (ACE) pumps.
output: The technology automatically increases, decreases, and suspends delivery of basal insulin, and delivers correction boluses when glucose values are predicted to exceed a predefined threshold, based on iCGM readings and predicted glucose values.
roleInDecisionMaking: Control-IQ+ technology automates insulin delivery decisions by increasing, decreasing, or suspending basal insulin and delivering correction boluses. Users must still follow instructions for use and rely on the pump for therapy decisions, especially if the smartphone app is incompatible or loses connectivity.
intendedUsers: Persons 2 years of age and greater with type 1 diabetes mellitus, and persons 18 years of age and greater with type 2 diabetes mellitus, who require insulin and use compatible insulin pumps and iCGMs. Users must follow the instructions for use for all system components.
targetPatientPopulation: Individuals 2 years of age and greater with type 1 diabetes mellitus, and individuals 18 years of age and greater with type 2 diabetes mellitus, who require insulin therapy. Minimum requirements include being 2 years or older, or 18 years or older for type 2 diabetes, and requiring at least 5 units of insulin per day or weighing at least 20 pounds (9 kilograms).
knownPerformanceLimitations: Control-IQ+ technology should not be used in individuals under 2 years old with type 1 diabetes or under 18 years old with type 2 diabetes. It is also contraindicated for patients requiring less than 5 units of total daily insulin or weighing less than 20 pounds (9 kilograms). Failure to follow instructions may lead to over-delivery or under-delivery of insulin, causing hypoglycemia or hyperglycemia.
requiredClinicianOversight: The device is available by prescription only ("RX ONLY"), indicating that clinician involvement is required for prescription and potentially initial setup or training. Users must use the system components in accordance with their instructions for use.

trainingData.description: A study was conducted using a t:slim X2 insulin pump with Control-IQ technology and Dexcom G6 sensor.

modelDevelopmentAndValidation.description: A study on t:slim X2 insulin pump with Control-IQ technology and Dexcom G6 sensor was conducted and published.

clinicalTrial.description: A study was conducted using a t:slim X2 insulin pump with Control-IQ technology and a Dexcom G6 sensor. This study was referenced as: Beck RW, et al. Diabetes Technol Ther. 2023;25(5):329-342.

performance.summary: A study conducted using a t:slim X2 insulin pump with Control-IQ technology and Dexcom G6 sensor has been referenced.

performanceEvaluationLimitations: Control-IQ+ technology has specific usage restrictions, including not being for persons under 2 years old with type 1 diabetes or under 18 with type 2 diabetes, or those requiring less than 5 units of insulin/day or weighing less than 20 pounds (9 kg). Users must follow instructions for all system components; failure to do so can lead to over or under delivery of insulin, causing hypoglycemia or hyperglycemia. The mobile app for bolus delivery requires a compatible smartphone, and users should always rely on the pump for therapy decisions if the smartphone is incompatible, lost, damaged, or loses Bluetooth connectivity.
ongoingMonitoringPlan: The Tandem support team is available 24 hours a day, 365 days a year. The company also offers mobile and cloud-based applications designed to help users see therapy data and better manage diabetes.
scheduledUpdates: Tandem insulin pumps are capable of remote software updates. However, future updates for some products may not be developed or offered everywhere and are subject to regulatory approvals. Software updates are only available to customers with pumps under warranty, may require additional training, and charges may apply.
